about_the_game:
An Anime-Fantasy World to Dive Into

Begin your journey in the peaceful village of Arbor, nestled beneath the towering Mother Tree Celestia. Talk to villagers, help them with their problems, explore the surroundings, and battle dangerous creatures to grow stronger.
But remember: this is just the beginning. A vast magical world awaits.

The Story of the Awakened

You are not just a traveler. A mysterious awakening grants you a power you don’t yet understand… one that could reshape the world — or destroy it.
Immerse yourself in a story of fate, power, and difficult choices.

Character Customization and Classless Progression

Choose from 9 unique races, customize your hero’s appearance, and set out in your own style.
Forget fixed classes: learn up to ten active abilities from a pool of over a hundred, and unlock perks that enhance your playstyle.
No limits — only choices.

Attributes That Evolve With Your Actions

Forget about boring point allocation. All 7 attributes grow naturally, based on how you play:

  • Strength — melee combat, physical power, heavy equipment

  • Charisma — persuasion, summoning, aura

  • Intelligence — crafting, analysis, learning

  • Wisdom — magical knowledge and spell schools

  • Dexterity — agility, evasion, stealth

  • Bodytype — survival, defense, adaptability

  • Perception — archery, senses, investigation

An Intuitive Probability System

All gameplay calculations are based on the Central Limit Theorem.
Every action has a real chance of critical success — or failure. Your attributes matter, and every check can change everything.

Loot, Crafting, and Enchantments — Without the Grind

Equip your hero with weapons, armor, trinkets, and consumables that can be strengthened… or lost.

  • Discover rare items in chests scattered across the world

  • Trade or craft your own gear

  • Enchant equipment with magical crystals

  • Gather ingredients and unlock alchemy recipes for powerful potions

content_descriptors.notes:
The game features stylized fantasy violence, including sword combat, magic attacks such as fireballs (burning), and animated death sequences of humanoid and non-humanoid enemies.
While the art style is not realistic, players can expect frequent combat and depictions of characters being defeated or destroyed in battle.
No explicit sexual content or real-world sensitive themes are included.
